overview.title: Dichterliebe no. 2
overview.summary: Dichterliebe no. 2 belongs to the Romantic era — music by Robert Schumann.
overview.history: Dichterliebe no. 2 is ready to explore on Lune. It is associated with Robert Schumann. Stylistically it sits in the Romantic world. Start by listening, then ask about the bars that surprise your hands. Place every phrase in the Romantic sound-world: how would someone from that time shape it?
highlights: Place every phrase in the Romantic sound-world: how would someone from that time shape it?

eraInfo.label: Romantic
eraInfo.story: Emotion, colour, and storytelling. Expect sweeping lines, rich harmony, and moments that feel like scenes from a novel.

composerInfo.name: Robert Schumann
composerInfo.hook: Schumann’s music feels like diary pages — poetic, sudden, deeply personal.
composerInfo.bio: He composed in all the main musical genres of the time, writing for solo piano, voice and piano, chamber groups, orchestra, choir and the opera. His works typify the spirit of the Romantic era in German music.
composerInfo.full: Robert Schumann was a German composer, pianist, and music critic of the early Romantic era. He composed in all the main musical genres of the time, writing for solo piano, voice and piano, chamber groups, orchestra, choir and the opera. His works typify the spirit of the Romantic era in German music.
highlights: Schumann is closely tied to the piano — tone and touch are part of the story.
